## Objetivo
Finish visual consistency and accessible interactions across existing screens without adding product features. Add measurable layout/accessibility assertions and a documented nonblocking manual review checklist mapped to screenshot evidence. Keep integrated functional journeys in T06 and execution documentation in T07.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] Browser layout tests at 1280x720 and 390x844 assert document scrollWidth <= clientWidth, visible critical poll/play-form actions with nonintersecting bounding boxes and heights >=44 CSS pixels, accessible names for interactive controls and keyboard-reachable primary actions with a visible focus indicator. At desktop the main content occupies >=80% of viewport width and the planning/collection composition includes at least two adjacent content panels. Representative long titles and validation messages cause no horizontal overflow; mobile uses stacked content rather than compressed tables.
- [ ] Automated style checks on representative screens verify normal text contrast >=4.5:1 and large text/control boundaries >=3:1 against rendered backgrounds, distinct computed heading/body/label typography, shared spacing/control tokens and styled inputs/buttons. Tests cover collection-empty, no-suggestions and invalid-play states with an actionable message, retaining relevant entered form values. Capture each state after scrolling its evidence into view, at both viewports, using the existing diagnostics helpers and viewport-only screenshots. npm test, npm run typecheck, npm run build and the full suite remain green.
- [ ] docs/visual-review.md exists. A fast text assertion verifies a checklist covering useful desktop width, styled controls, typographic hierarchy, consistent spacing, empty/error panels, contrast, mobile clipping/overlap/overflow and phone poll/score usability. Each row names the corresponding screenshot state, expected result and fields for reviewer notes and pass/fail/not-reviewed. The document states that automated assertions are blocking, while visual judgment is a nonblocking manual review, with no requirement to fabricate completed human sign-off.
- [ ] (manual) Review the mapped desktop/phone captures against every checklist row for the warm neutral/forest-green palette, deliberate hierarchy and spacing, polished empty/error states and comfortable poll/score controls. Record observations and any remaining issues in the checklist; this subjective review does not block automated acceptance.
